subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Paid annual leave each year
context: The minimum paid annual leave for employees covered by the National Employment Standards. Casual employees are not covered.

subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Extra paid annual leave for some shiftworkers
context: An additional week of paid annual leave on top of the minimum, for some shiftworkers.

subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
subject_intro: Employees covered by the National Employment Standards get {fact:au_annual_leave_weeks} of paid annual leave a year, and some shiftworkers get {fact:au_annual_leave_shift_extra} more.
subject_meta_description: How much paid annual leave employees get in Australia under the National Employment Standards: {fact:au_annual_leave_weeks} a year, plus {fact:au_annual_leave_shift_extra} more for some shiftworkers.

subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Paid sick and carer's leave each year
context: The minimum paid sick and carer's leave for employees covered by the National Employment Standards. It is pro rata for part-time employees and does not reach casual employees.

subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Unpaid carer's leave when needed
context: Up to this many days of unpaid carer's leave as required. Casual employees can take it for each occasion.

subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Compassionate leave when needed
context: Up to this many days of compassionate leave as required. Casual employees can take it, unpaid, for each occasion.

subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Paid family and domestic violence leave each year
context: The paid family and domestic violence leave available to employees each year. Casual employees are covered, counted over a 12-month period.

subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
subject_intro: Employees get {fact:au_sick_leave_days} of paid sick and carer's leave under the National Employment Standards, plus unpaid carer's leave, compassionate leave and paid family and domestic violence leave.
subject_meta_description: Paid sick and carer's leave in Australia: {fact:au_sick_leave_days}, plus unpaid carer's leave, compassionate leave and {fact:au_fdv_leave_days} of paid family and domestic violence leave.
